Law (muloiwa_2020_free_laws eq 13):
  \mu=\mu_{max}\Bigg[1-\Bigg(\frac{S}{S_{m}}\Bigg)\Bigg]^{n}\left[\frac{S}{S+K_{s}\Big(1-\frac{S}{S_{m}}\Big)^{m}}\right]
  as transcribed: mu = mumax*(1-S_/Sm)**n*(S_/(S_+Ks*(1-S_/Sm)**m))
Law variables to map:
  S_: Substrate concentration [?]
  mu: Specific bacteria growth rate [1 / s]   <- the quantity the law computes
Law parameters (not mapped): Ks, Sm, m, mumax, n

Model symbols (the rate symbol is r):
  r: specific rate in the biomass and substrate balance equations [1 / h]
  u1: dilution factor [1 / h]
  u2: substrate concentration in the feed [g / l]
  x1: measured concentration [g / l]
  x2: substrate concentration [g / l]

answer.note: S_ is substrate concentration, matching x2. The law’s specific growth rate mu maps to the model’s specific rate r; convert units from 1/s to 1/h as needed.
